_note: Metric ontology. Two reported numbers are comparable only if the metric id AND every protocol field in 'comparability_fields' agree (unknown counts as disagreement-unknown).

metrics.label: Pearson correlation
pitfalls: Computed across genes vs across cells vs across samples gives different numbers
Pooled correlation is inflated by between-group mean differences (Simpson-like effects)
Averaging per-group r is not the same as pooled r
Sensitive to outliers and to log/normalization choice

metrics.label: Spearman rank correlation
metrics.definition: ρ = Pearson(rank(y), rank(ŷ)) with average ranks for ties
pitfalls: Per-gene vs per-cell vs per-perturbation vs pooled computation
Mean of per-group ρ vs median vs pooled
Many ties (zeros in sparse data) change ρ
Computing on deltas vs raw expression changes meaning

metrics.label: Mean squared error
pitfalls: Scale-dependent: incomparable across normalizations
Dominated by high-variance features

metrics.label: Root mean squared error
pitfalls: Scale-dependent

metrics.label: Mean absolute error
pitfalls: Scale-dependent

metrics.label: Coefficient of determination
pitfalls: Not equal to Pearson r² for non-OLS predictions
Depends on which mean defines SS_tot

metrics.label: Area under ROC curve
pitfalls: Insensitive to class imbalance; can look high when precision is poor
Negative set construction (random vs shuffled vs matched) changes values drastically
Macro vs micro averaging across tasks

metrics.label: Area under precision-recall curve
pitfalls: Baseline equals positive prevalence: not comparable across different imbalance
Interpolation method (trapezoid vs step AP) differs

metrics.label: F1 score
pitfalls: Threshold-dependent
Macro vs micro vs weighted averaging

metrics.label: Accuracy
pitfalls: Misleading under class imbalance

metrics.label: Recall@K
pitfalls: Depends on candidate set size
Per-query average vs pooled

metrics.label: Energy distance / MMD between predicted and observed distributions
pitfalls: Feature space (PCA dims, genes) changes the value
Sample size bias
